chatrooms.nameInvalid: Enter a name between 1 and 200 characters.
chatrooms.deleteConfirm: Delete chatroom? All messages will be permanently removed.
chatrooms.emptyDescription: Create a chatroom and bind agents to start conversations.

chatroom.agentModelHintUnserviceable: This agent's selected provider has no available key. Ask a project owner to carry or add a matching provider key.
chatroom.agentFailed: The agent run failed. Please try again.
chatroom.agentProviderQuota: Every key in this agent's key group is at its provider quota. Try again shortly, or add a key with quota left to the group.
chatroom.agentProviderErrors: Every key in this agent's key group failed its call. The usual causes are an invalid or unauthorised key, or a model id the provider does not accept.
chatroom.agentProviderRejected: The provider rejected the request. Check the agent's model settings and the key's permissions.
chatroom.agentProviderExhausted: No usable key is left in this agent's key group. Check the keys' quota and status.
chatroom.agentProviderStreamFailed: The connection to the provider broke mid-reply. Please try again.
chatroom.agentDatabaseError: A database error occurred while saving the agent's reply. Try again; contact an administrator if it persists.
chatroom.agentRateLimited: The agent is replying too often right now. Try again in a moment.
chatroom.agentUnavailable: That agent is no longer available to respond.
chatroom.agentKnowledgeStarved: This turn left no room for the agent's knowledge sources, so it did not reply rather than answer without them. Raise the agent's token cap, or send a shorter message.
chatroom.exportQueued: Export queued ({jobId}). Download will be ready shortly.
chatroom.editFailed: Could not edit — it may be past the 5-minute window or changed elsewhere.
chatroom.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? This removes it for everyone and cannot be undone.
chatroom.deleteSummaryNotice: If this message has already been folded into a conversation summary, that summary keeps its own wording of it and is not rewritten.
chatroom.railResize: Resize the side panel. Use the arrow keys to adjust, Home and End for the limits, Enter to reset.
chatroom.uploadNotReady: Attachments aren't ready yet — please try again in a moment.
chatroom.searchJumpUnavailable: That message is in older history — scroll up to load it.
chatroom.emptyText: Start the conversation by typing a message below, or wait for a bound agent to respond.

observers.emptyText: Observers write here after they analyze the conversation. Only you can see these.
observers.noObserverBoundText: These are past analyses from an observer that is no longer bound to this room. You can still release or delete them.
observers.loadError: Could not load observations. The list below may be incomplete or out of date.

basis.server_facts: Basis: computed by the server over this room's submissions. It counts submissions, not participants, and says nothing about who did not submit.
basis.recent_window: Basis: read off the recent-activity window, which holds only the most recent events and is not a complete record of the room.
basis.transcript: Basis: read off what was said in the room. A description of the discussion, not a measurement.

blocks.truncated: Showing the {n} most recent; this room has more.
blocks.cannotDisplay: This block needs a newer version of the interface to display.

observers.targetRoomHelp: Everyone in the room sees it as an analysis released by you.
observers.targetRoomHelpDisclosed: Everyone in the room sees it as an analysis released by you. The observer's name will be attached.
observers.targetAgentsHelp: Selected agents receive it in their next turn; the room sees nothing.
observers.noEligibleAgents: No eligible agents in this room.
observers.wakeHelp: Otherwise agents read it the next time they act. Undelivered notes expire after 24 hours.
observers.deleteConfirm: Delete this observation? This cannot be undone.
observers.disclosureTooltip: The room owner receives private analyses of this conversation.
observers.releasedByOwner: Analysis released by the room owner
observers.releasedByOwnerNamed: Analysis from {name}, released by the room owner
observers.observerRoleHelp: Analyzes the conversation silently. Output is visible only to you until you release it.
observers.discloseOnHelp: Members see a notice that observers are enabled (never which agent or any output).
observers.discloseOffHelp: Members are not informed. Check your organization's policy before disabling.
observers.guestObserverCallout: This room has an active guest link and a bound observer. External guests are never shown the observer indicator, whatever the disclosure setting above says, so they are observed without notice.

settings.deleteDesc: Permanently remove this chatroom and all messages. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete this chatroom and all its messages? This cannot be undone.
settings.compactDesc: Merge old messages to reduce storage. This action cannot be undone.
settings.compactConfirm: Compact chatroom history? Older messages will be merged. This cannot be undone.
settings.noAgents: No agents in this project yet.
settings.roleChangeFailed: Failed to change the agent role.
settings.versionConflict: This chatroom changed elsewhere. Review your edits and save again.
settings.activityControlFailed: Could not update activity control for this agent.
settings.activityControlNeedsTypes: Pick at least one activity before granting control.
settings.draftAccessFailed: Could not update unsent-text permission for this agent.
settings.allowMemberGroupsDesc: Only members of the groups selected below. Turning this on closes the room to the rest of the project.
settings.memberGroupsExclusiveTitle: This changes who can enter the room
settings.memberGroupsExclusiveWarning: Access for all project members will be turned off, because a room cannot use both tiers. From then on, only people in a group you select below can reach this room — anyone in no group loses access immediately, including guests, who cannot belong to a group at all. Add every participant to a group before you continue.
settings.boundGroupsDesc: Members of any selected group can read and send here.
settings.boundGroupsFailed: Could not update the groups for this room
settings.boundGroupsLoadFailed: Could not load this room's group access. Retry before editing it.
settings.noGroupsYet: This project has no member groups yet

conceptMap.workspacePrivacyHelp: When on, a Concept Map can be built across this workspace's shared knowledge. Off by default to keep wide-layer knowledge private.
conceptMap.privacyOwnerOnly: Only a project owner can change this setting.
conceptMap.privacyToggleFailed: Failed to update the privacy setting.
conceptMap.chatroomInheritsAccess: This chatroom's Concept Map inherits the room's access control — anyone who can view the room can view its Concept Map.

guest.title: Join Chatroom
guest.description: Enter a display name to join the chatroom.
guest.error: Failed to join. The link may be invalid or expired.
guest.invalidToken: This link is no longer valid. The chatroom may have been deleted or guest access may have been disabled.
guest.networkError: Could not connect. Please check your connection and try again.

drafts.discloseLabel: Tell people when an agent can read what they are typing
drafts.discloseOnHelp: Everyone in this room sees a small notice on the message box and the activity panel whenever an agent here can read unsent text.
drafts.discloseOffHelp: Nobody is told. If you have also given an agent permission to read unsent text, people will be typing in front of it without knowing.
drafts.undisclosedCallout: An agent in this room can read what people are typing before they send it, and this room does not tell them. Turning the notice back on is the only thing that does.

draftAccess.label: May read unsent text
draftAccess.help: Lets this agent read what people in this room are typing but have not sent: the message box, and any activity worksheet in progress. It reads only when it decides to, it never sees names, and nothing is saved. This applies to this room only and you can revoke it at any time.
draftAccess.undisclosedNote: This room does not tell people it is happening. Turn the notice on above.
draftAccess.confirmTitle: Let this agent read unsent text?
draftAccess.confirmBody: This agent will be able to read what people in this room are typing before they send it, including half-finished activity answers. Everyone here will see a notice that it can. Only give this to an agent you would be comfortable telling your students about.
draftAccess.confirmBodyUndisclosed: This agent will be able to read what people in this room are typing before they send it, including half-finished activity answers. This room currently does NOT tell them it is happening. Nobody in the room will know.

activityControl.label: May start and end activities
activityControl.help: Lets this agent start and end the activities you tick below, in this room only. You can still start and end anything yourself, and you can revoke this at any time.
activityControl.noTypes: This project has no activity types yet. Register one before delegating control.
activityControl.unresolved: {count} previously selected activity is no longer available to this project and will not be offered to the agent.
activityControl.observerNote: This agent is an observer: the class never sees it speak, but starting or ending a round is something the whole class sees.
activityControl.typesLoadFailed: Could not load this project's activity types, so there is nothing to pick from. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, you may not have permission to list them.
